clusters.pick_reason: #3056 unwraps `Annotated[...]` before inspecting union members via `_unwrap_annotated`, so it correctly skips pre-parsing for the common `Annotated[str, Field(description=...)] | None` idiom. #2032's `_should_pre_parse_json` checks `arg not in _SIMPLE_TYPES` without unwrapping Annotated, so for that same `Annotated[str, Field(...)] | None` case the Annotated member is never in `_SIMPLE_TYPES` and the function still returns True, leaving the corruption bug unfixed for annotated/described optional-string parameters — arguably the most common real-world shape this bug affects. #2032 does cover a broader set of unions (any all-JSON-primitive union, e.g. `str | int`), but that wider behavior change isn't exercised by its tests against the Annotated case, so it doesn't fully close the reported bug.

members.cluster_pick_reason: #3056 unwraps `Annotated[...]` before inspecting union members via `_unwrap_annotated`, so it correctly skips pre-parsing for the common `Annotated[str, Field(description=...)] | None` idiom. #2032's `_should_pre_parse_json` checks `arg not in _SIMPLE_TYPES` without unwrapping Annotated, so for that same `Annotated[str, Field(...)] | None` case the Annotated member is never in `_SIMPLE_TYPES` and the function still returns True, leaving the corruption bug unfixed for annotated/described optional-string parameters — arguably the most common real-world shape this bug affects. #2032 does cover a broader set of unions (any all-JSON-primitive union, e.g. `str | int`), but that wider behavior change isn't exercised by its tests against the Annotated case, so it doesn't fully close the reported bug.

clusters.pick_reason: #2478 fixes the bug at the MCPError base-class level via a shared `_restore_mcp_error` dispatcher, so every MCPError subclass gets safe pickling, and it explicitly special-cases UrlElicitationRequiredError (dispatching to `from_error` instead of `from_error_data`) inside that same helper — covering the exact case #2555 targets. #2555 only adds a `__reduce__` to UrlElicitationRequiredError itself, leaving MCPError and any other subclass still broken. #2478 also removes the stale `# pragma: no cover` on `MCPError.data`, indicating its fix path is now exercised by tests generically rather than for one subclass only.

clusters.pick_reason: #3063 keys `_request_streams` off `str(message.id)`, which collapses distinct ids (integer `1` and string `"1"` both become `"1"`) and doesn't guard against a string id colliding with the `GET_STREAM_KEY` sentinel (`"_GET_stream"`) used for the standalone GET stream. #3221 replaces this with a type-preserving `_request_stream_key()` helper (`i:`/`s:` prefixes) that keeps int/string ids distinct and can't collide with `GET_STREAM_KEY`, closing edge cases #3063's simpler in-flight check leaves open while addressing the same duplicate-request-id routing bug.
